blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models leave model-specific traces in their generated text, but it remains unclear how finely these fingerprints can distinguish related models and which signals remain informative as obvious cues are reduced. We study this through fingerprint resolution, considering both model resolution, from different families to distilled and adapted variants, and signal resolution across behavioral, stylometric, lexical, and semantic evidence. We progressively suppress surface cues, paraphrase outputs, vary the amount of available text, and test generalization across prompt distributions and languages. Our results show that fingerprints persist beyond broad family differences, remaining detectable in distilled models and even LoRA adaptations of the same base model. Although attribution weakens as surface and lexical cues are altered, substantial model-specific signal remains. These signals transfer across prompt sources and languages, with semantic representations proving most robust across languages. These findings show that model identity is recoverable at multiple resolutions, but that recoverability depends on model similarity and the evidence available in the text.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型在生成的文字中留下了模型特有的痕迹,但目前仍不清楚这些指纹如何细微区分相关模型,以及随着明显提示的减少,哪些信号仍然具有信息性. 我们通过指纹解析来研究这个问题, 考虑两种模型解析, 从不同的家族来提炼和调整变体, 和信号解析 跨行为、定型、词汇和语义证据。 我们逐渐压制表面提示,解释输出,改变可用的文本数量,并测试各种迅速分发和语言的通用性。 我们的结果显示,指纹持续存在,超越了广泛的家族差异,在蒸馏模型中仍然可以检测到,甚至同基模型的LORA改编. 虽然归属随着表面和词汇提示的改变而减弱,但实质性的模型特定信号仍然存在. 这些信号通过快速源和语言进行传输,语言之间的语义表述证明最为有力。 这些调查结果表明,模型身份在多个分辨率中是可以恢复的,但可恢复性取决于模型的相似性和文本中可用的证据.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
LLMs often leave recognizable traces in their generated text, making it possible to distinguish among different source models ( Uchendu et al., 2020 ; Rao et al., 2025 ; Antoun et al., 2024 ) . Some traces are easy to observe when a model generates text, such as producing longer responses, using more headings, following particular formatting conventions, or beginning answers in recurring ways. Such signals can make attribution relatively easy, but they are also fragile, and post-generation editing can weaken text-based detectors ( Krishna et al., 2023 ; Dugan et al., 2024 ) .
What remains unclear is which model-specific signals survive when these visible cues are reduced, especially when the candidate models are closely related. We therefore ask: how finely can the identity of an LLM be resolved from its generated text, and which properties of the text still reveal that identity?
blocks.zh:
LLMs在其生成的文本中经常留下可识别的痕迹,从而有可能区分出不同的源模型(Uchendu等人,2020年;Rao等人,2025年;Antoun等人,2024年)。 当一个模型生成文本时,有些痕迹很容易被观察到,例如产生较长的答复,使用更多的标题,遵循特定格式的公约,或以反复出现的方式开始回答。 这种信号可以使归属相对容易,但也是脆弱的,生成后编辑可以削弱以文字为基础的探测器(Krishna等,2023;Dugan等,2024.).
尚不清楚的是,当这些可见信号减少时,特别是当候选模型密切相关时,哪些模型特定信号仍能幸存. 因此,我们问:如何从生成的文本中精确地解决LLM的特性,文本的哪些属性仍然揭示出这种特性?

blocks.en: This question is increasingly important as modern LLMs become more diverse and increasingly appear as closely related model families rather than isolated systems. Different sizes, distilled descendants, and adapted variants may share architectures, training histories, or development processes while differing only in subtle ways, making source attribution more difficult. At the same time, generated text may be reformatted, edited, shortened, or paraphrased before attribution, weakening or removing model-identifying signals. Attribution must therefore address two related challenges by distinguishing increasingly similar models and determining which identifying signals remain observable after the text is transformed.
blocks.zh: 这个问题越来越重要,因为现代有限责任公司变得更加多样化,越来越成为密切相关的模范家庭,而不是孤立的系统。 大小不同,分馏后人,以及被改造的变体可能共享建筑,培训历史,或发展进程,而仅以微妙的方式不同,使得源的归属更加困难. 同时,生成的文本可能在归属前被重写,编辑,缩短,或被作变写,削弱或去除模型识别信号. 因此,归属必须解决两个相关的挑战,区分日益相似的模式,并确定哪些识别信号在文本被转换后仍可观测。

blocks.en: We study this problem through fingerprint resolution , illustrated in Figure 1 . Model resolution describes how attribution changes as candidate generators become more similar, from different families to within-family models, distilled descendants, and controlled LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) adaptations. Signal resolution describes which behavioral, stylometric, lexical, and semantic signals carry model identity and whether they survive as observable cues are reduced. Together, these complementary axes distinguish the existence of a fingerprint from the conditions under which it remains detectable.
blocks.zh: 我们通过指纹解析来研究这一问题,如图1所示。 模型解析(Model Resolution)描述了因候选发电机而导致的归属变化如何变得更加相似,从不同的家庭模式到家庭内部模式,蒸馏出后人,以及控制了LORA(Hu等,2022年)的适应. 信号分辨率描述的是哪些行为信号,时态信号,语法信号和语义信号带有模型身份,以及它们是否作为可观察到的提示而活下来被降低. 这些互补轴共同将指纹的存在与仍然可被检测到的条件区分开来.

blocks.en:
Prior work has shown that source models can be identified using lexical and grammatical patterns, learned representations, and supervised attribution models ( McGovern et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . Our goal is to use model attribution as a diagnostic tool rather than treat accuracy as the endpoint. We progressively remove observable cues, paraphrase model outputs, and control the amount of available text to determine which behavioral, stylometric, lexical, and semantic signals continue to reveal model identity.
We further test whether fingerprints generalize beyond the conditions under which they are learned. Source-held-out experiments measure transfer across prompt distributions, while within- and cross-language experiments evaluate English, Chinese, and Persian. These settings address evidence that source attribution may weaken across languages ( La Cava et al., 2026 ) and that fingerprint visibility can depend on language ( Gloaguen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
先前的研究表明,可以使用词法和语法模式、学到的表述以及监督的归属模型确定源模型(McGovern等,2025;Sun等,2025;Lu等,2026)。 我们的目标是将模型归属作为诊断工具,而不是把准确性作为终点。 我们逐渐去除可观测到的提示,解说模型输出,并控制可用文本的数量,以确定哪些行为,时态,词汇,和语义信号继续显示模型身份.
我们进一步检验指纹是否超出所了解的条件。 源控出实验测量跨即时分布的转移,而内语和跨语实验则评价英语,中文和波斯语. 这些设置涉及以下证据:来源归属可能削弱跨语言(La Cava等,2026年),指纹能见度取决于语言(Gloaguen等,2026年).

blocks.en:
Our results show that model fingerprints extend beyond broad family differences and remain detectable even between distilled models and their teachers, as well as between LoRA-adapted versions of the same base model.
Attribution becomes harder as behavioral and stylometric cues are removed and lexical choices are altered through paraphrasing. Cross-lingual experiments show that semantic representations provide the most reliable transfer across languages, while cross-dataset results show substantial transfer across prompt sources but sharp degradation for highly constrained generation tasks. Model identity is therefore recoverable at different resolutions depending on model similarity and the evidence available in generated text.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果显示,模型指纹超越了广泛的家庭差异,即使在蒸馏模型及其教师之间,以及同一基模型的LORA所适应的版本之间,也仍然可以检测出。
随着行为和定型提示被去掉,并通过旁白来改变词汇选择,归属变得更难. 多种语言的实验表明,语义表达提供了最可靠的语言间转移,而跨数据集的结果表明,由于高度受限的生成任务,迅速源之间的转移量很大,但急剧下降。 因此,根据模型相似性和生成文本中的现有证据,模型身份在不同决议中是可以恢复的。

blocks.en: Our key contributions are threefold: (1) A fingerprint-resolution framework spanning different levels of model similarity, revealing distinguishable fingerprints even in distilled models and LoRA-adapted variants of the same base model; (2) A decomposition of model-identifying evidence using multiple signal families, progressive cue suppression, paraphrasing, and varying the amount of available text; and (3) A broad evaluation of fingerprint generalization across unseen prompt distributions, different generation tasks, and within- and cross-language settings in English, Chinese, and Persian.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献有三: (1)指纹解析框架,涵盖不同水平的模型相似性,即使在同基模型的蒸馏模型和LORA调整后变体中也能发现可分辨出指纹;(2)利用多相信号家族,渐进提示压制,抛出,并改变可用文本数量对模型识别证据进行分解;(3)广泛评价指纹的概括性,涵盖不可见的即时分布,不同的生成任务,以及英语,汉语,波斯语的内语和跨语境.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior work has shown that LLM-generated text contains model-specific signals that can be used to identify its source. These signals appear at different levels, from broad differences associated with model family and size ( Antoun et al., 2024 ) to finer patterns in vocabulary, character use, and sentence structure that can persist across domains ( McGovern et al., 2025 ) . Other approaches use learned representations, contrastive learning, or specialized attribution models to improve source classification ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Bitton et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; La Cava and Tagarelli, 2025 ) . Distinguishing signals can even emerge among closely related models that differ only in training details such as initialization or data order ( Suzuki et al., 2025 ; Tong et al., 2026 ) .
Together, these studies establish that model identity is often recoverable from generated text. Less clear is how that recoverability changes as candidate models become more similar and as the available identifying cues are progressively removed.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作表明,LLM生成的文本包含可以用来识别其出处的模型特定信号. 这些信号在不同层次上出现,从与模范家族和大小(Antoun等人,2024年)有关的广泛差异到词汇、字符使用和句子结构的更细化的模式,这些模式可以跨越不同领域(McGovern等人,2025年)。 其他方法利用学到的表述、对比性学习或专门的归属模型来改进源分类(Sun等,2025;Bitton等,2025;Lu等,2026;Guo等,2024;La Cava和Tagarelli,2025)。 区分信号甚至可能在密切相关的模型中出现,这些模型仅在初始化或数据顺序等培训细节上有所不同(铃木等,2025;Tong等,2026).
这些研究共同确定,模型身份往往可以从生成的文本中恢复。 不太清楚的是,随着候选模式变得更加相似,随着现有识别提示被逐渐去除,可回收性的变化是如何发生的。

blocks.en:
Several studies have also examined the robustness of model attribution. Some control for response length and formatting or apply transformations such as translation and summarization ( Sun et al., 2025 ; McGovern et al., 2025 ) . Related detection benchmarks show that robustness can deteriorate when outputs come from previously unseen generators ( Li et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .
Ownership-oriented methods take a different approach by implanting private trigger-response behaviors or probing models with selected prompts and repeated observations ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Pasquini et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) . Our setting is complementary. Rather than optimizing prompts or attribution models, we study passive attribution from ordinary model outputs and ask how much identifying information remains when text is shortened, reformatted, partly rewritten, or paraphrased. This motivates our view of fingerprinting as a resolution problem, determined jointly by the similarity of the candidate models and the amount and type of evidence that remains observable.
blocks.zh:
若干研究还审查了模型归属的可靠性。 对响应长度和格式化或应用转换的一些控制,如翻译和归纳(Sun等,2025;McGovern等,2025.). 相关检测基准表明,当产出来自先前未见的发电机时,强度可能会恶化(Li等,2024;Wang等,2024)。
以所有权为导向的方法采取了不同的做法,将私人触发反应行为或检测模型植入到选定的提示和重复观测中(徐等,2024;帕斯奎尼等,2025;高等等,2025)。 我们的环境是相辅相成的。 我们不是优化提示或归属模型,而是研究普通模型产出的被动归属,并询问在文本被缩短、重新编排、部分改写或被解释时,还剩下多少识别信息。 这促使我们把指纹确定为一个解决的问题,由候选人模型的相似性以及仍然可观察的证据的数量和类型共同决定。

blocks.en: A smaller body of work considers multilingual attribution. Recent results suggest that source-model attribution does not always transfer reliably across languages ( La Cava et al., 2026 ; Greco et al., 2026 ) , while semantically conditioned watermarking shows that language can be used as a channel for embedding model-specific signals ( Gloaguen et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, we focus on naturally occurring model fingerprints rather than deliberately embedded signals, and examine which behavioral, lexical, and semantic cues remain informative within and across English, Chinese, and Persian.
blocks.zh: 较小的工作体会到多种语文的归属。 最近的结果表明,源模式归属并不总是可靠地在语言之间转移(La Cava等人,2026;Greco等人,2026;而有固定条件的水标记表明,语言可以用作嵌入模型特定信号的通道(Gloaguen等人,2026)。 相反,我们关注的是自然产生的模型指纹,而不是刻意嵌入的信号,并研究哪些行为、词汇和语义提示在英语、中文和波斯语内部和相互之间仍然具有信息性。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 2 , most prior work frames attribution as a closed-set classification task in which a generated response is assigned to one of several predefined candidate models and performance is summarized by a single score. While this formulation establishes whether model-specific signals are recoverable, it provides limited insight into how attribution changes as candidate models become increasingly similar or which properties of the generated text support the prediction. These questions matter because modern LLMs often appear as closely related variants and because their outputs may be altered before attribution. We study these factors through fingerprint resolution .
blocks.zh: 如第2节所讨论,大多数以前的工作框架归属作为封闭式分类任务,其中生成的回复被分配到若干预先确定的候选模式之一,业绩以一分汇总. 虽然这种提法确定了模型特定信号是否可以被恢复,但对于作为候选模型的归属变化如何变得越来越相近或生成文本的哪些属性支持预测提供了有限的见解. 这些问题之所以重要,是因为现代有限责任公司常常作为密切相关的变体出现,而且其产出在归属前可能会被改变。 我们通过指纹解析来研究这些因素。

blocks.en:
In this section, we first formalize attribution as a measure of fingerprint recoverability and then define model resolution (Sec. 3.1 ), signal representations (Sec. 3.2 ), and text transformations (Sec. 3.3 ) used to study both axes of fingerprint resolution.
We then study these two axes jointly in Sec. 4 and examine whether the resulting fingerprints generalize across prompt distributions and languages in Sec. 5 . Detailed generation, feature, and classifier settings are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们首先正式确定归属作为指纹可回收性的衡量标准,然后定义模型分辨率(Sec. 3.1),信号表示(Sec. 3.2),以及用于研究指纹分辨率两轴的文本转换(Sec. 3.3).
然后,我们用第4节共同研究这两个轴,并审查所产生的指纹是否在第5节迅速分发和各种语言中通用。 附录A提供了详细的生成、特性和分类器设置。

Given a response y y , the attribution task predicts its source model as M ^ = f ⁡ ( y ) \hat{M}=f(y) . Rather than treating the performance of f f as the endpoint, we use it as a measure of fingerprint recoverability. We examine how attribution changes along two complementary axes: model resolution , which varies how closely related the candidate generators are, and signal resolution , which varies the type and amount of model-identifying evidence available in their outputs.

blocks.en: 3.1 Model Resolution
blocks.zh: 3.1 示范决议

blocks.en: Model resolution is examined across four levels of similarity between candidate generators. Our primary model set contains 19 models from eight families and supports the cross-family and within-family experiments. Additional models are used for the distillation and controlled-adaptation settings. Complete model lists and exact identifiers are provided in Appendix A.1 . Across settings, we keep the attribution protocol as consistent as possible so that differences in performance primarily reflect the similarity between candidate models.
blocks.zh: 示范分辨率在候选发电机的相近性方面分为四个层次。 我们的主要模型集包含来自8个家庭的19个模型,并支持跨家庭和家庭内部的实验。 蒸馏和可控适应设置也使用其他模型. 完整的模型清单和准确的识别资料载于附录A.1。 在整个设置中,我们尽可能保持归属协议的一致性,以使性能的差异主要反映候选模式之间的相似性.

blocks.en:
• Cross-Family. We select one representative from each of the eight families: Llama-4 Maverick, Qwen-3 32B, Mistral-Small-3.2 24B, Gemma-4 31B, DeepSeek-V4 Flash-0731, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini-2.5 Flash, and GPT-4.1. • Within-Family. We compare all model pairs within families containing multiple models. This gives six Llama pairs, three Qwen pairs, and one pair each for other model families. • Distillation Relationships. We examine three teacher–student pairs: Llama-3.1 8B vs. Llama-3.1-Minitron 4B, Mistral-NeMo 12B vs. Mistral-NeMo-Minitron 8B, and Gemma-2 27B vs. Gemma-2 2B. • Controlled Adaptations. We use Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B as base models and fine-tune each on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) and MATH ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) using LoRA. We then vary the strength of the learned LoRA update to create a controlled sequence of adaptations and test when their outputs become distinguishable from those of the corresponding base model. The fine-tuning procedure and LoRA settings are described in
Appendix F .

blocks.en: 3.2 Signal Resolution: From Surface to Semantics
blocks.zh: 3.2 信号分辨率:从表面到语义

blocks.en: Signal resolution covers four complementary levels of model-identifying signals, ranging from surface-level behavioral patterns to semantic representations.
blocks.zh: 信号分辨率包括四个互补的模型识别信号层次,从表层行为模式到语义表达.

blocks.en: • Behavioral and Structural. These features capture how a model organizes and presents its response. They cover response length and structure, formatting and layout, punctuation, and repetition tendency. Representative examples include sentence and paragraph counts, headings and lists, punctuation usage, and bigram and trigram repetition ratios. • Stylometric. These features capture recurring patterns in vocabulary use and grammatical structure. We concatenate these two representations into a single lexical feature set. • Semantic. We use openai/text-embedding-3-small to obtain a fixed embedding for each response. This provides a semantic-level view that can capture model-specific information not explicitly represented by the manually defined or surface-form features.

blocks.en: Two additional derived representations are considered. First, for the prompt-neutralized embedding , we compute the mean embedding across all candidate-model responses to the same prompt and subtract this mean from each response embedding. This removes variation shared across models for that prompt and emphasizes differences between their responses. Because this setting requires peer responses from all candidate models for the same test prompt, it differs from standard attribution and is used as a diagnostic representation. If attribution improves after neutralization, it suggests that removing prompt- and task-shared variation exposes model-specific signals that are more discriminative and less dependent on the prompt itself. Second, the combined representation concatenates the four main signal groups described above to capture their complementary information. Complete feature definitions, vectorizer settings, and dimensionality limits are provided in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 考虑了另外两项衍生表述。 首先,对于迅速中和的嵌入,我们计算在所有候选模型反应中的平均嵌入,然后从每个反应嵌入中减去这个平均值。 这消除了各模型之间所共有的这种即时变化,并强调了它们的答复之间的差异。 由于这种设置需要所有候选模型对同一测试快取的同级响应,因此它与标准归属不同并被作为诊断性表示. 如果归属在中和后有所改进,它就表明去除即时和任务分担的变异会暴露出模型特有的信号,这些信号比较有歧视性并较少依赖即时本身. 第二,综合表示使上述四个主要信号组凝聚,以获取其补充信息. 完整的特征定义、矢量器设置和维度限制载于附录A.4。

blocks.en: To make the attribution setting more realistic, we use open-ended prompts and sample responses at temperature 1.0 1.0 , producing substantial generations; approximately 95 % 95\% of responses exceed 50 words. The main English experiments use four prompt sets, D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} , with 200 prompts from each source before filtering. D 1 D_{1} and D 2 D_{2} are independent samples from INFINITY-CHAT ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , D 3 D_{3} contains researcher-designed prompts spanning five task categories (construction described in Appendix A.2 ), and D 4 D_{4} comes from a separate general-prompt source ( Rajani et al., 2023 ) . After removing one near-duplicate, the final set contains 799 prompts. All models follow a common decoding protocol (Appendix A.3 ). The multilingual experiments in Sec. 5 extend this setup to English, Mandarin Chinese, and Persian by translating the English prompts with GPT-4o-mini.

D 1 D_{1}和D 2 D_{2}是INFINITY-CHAT(Jiang等,2026年)的独立样本,D 3 D_{3}包含由研究人员设计的包含五个任务类别的提示(附录A.2所描述的构造),而D 4 D_{4}来自一个单独的通用快取来源(Rajani等,2023年)。 在移除了一款相近的复制后,最终集包含有799个提示. 所有模型都遵循共同的解码协议(Appendix A.3. Sec. 5中的多语种实验通过用GBT-4o-mini来翻译英文提示来将这种设置扩展到英语,普通汉语,和波斯语.

blocks.en: For attribution, we use Logistic Regression (LR) as the primary diagnostic classifier and a one-hidden-layer MLP as a nonlinear robustness check. The main English experiments use five-fold, prompt-grouped, dataset-stratified cross-validation, keeping all outputs and response views associated with the same prompt within a single fold. We reuse the same fold assignments across experiments and report accuracy. Classifier settings and evaluation details are provided in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 为了归属,我们使用Logistic Regression(LR)作为初级诊断分级器,并使用一隐藏层的MLP作为非线性强性检查. 主要英语实验采用五倍,即时分组,数据集分级的交叉验证,将所有输出和与同快相关的响应视图保留在一个折叠内. 我们重复同样的折叠任务 通过实验和报告准确性。 分类设置和评价细节见附录A.6。

blocks.en: 4 Resolving Model Fingerprints
blocks.zh: 4 解决模型指纹

blocks.en: This section presents the results of the model- and signal-resolution experiments. Attribution is evaluated across different signal types while observable signals are progressively reduced to test whether model fingerprints persist. The analysis also spans increasing levels of model similarity, from distinct model families to closely related adaptations of the same base model. Neither LR nor the MLP consistently outperforms the other across settings. We therefore report LR results throughout the main text and provide the corresponding MLP results in the Appendices B and D .
blocks.zh: 本节介绍模型和信号分辨率实验的结果. 对不同信号类型的归属进行评价,同时逐步减少可观测信号,以检验模型指纹是否继续存在。 分析还涉及越来越多的模式相似性,从不同的模式家庭到对同一基本模式的密切相关的调整。 LR 和 MLP 在不同的设置中都无法一贯地超越其他设置。 因此,我们报告整个主要案文的LR结果,并在附录B和D中提供相应的MLP结果。

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the eight-way cross-family attribution results, with a chance level of 12.5%. The results show that attribution relies on more than formatting signals and response templates. Behavioral features show the largest relative decline under edge cropping (T1) and formatting removal (T2), consistent with their direct encoding of response structure, while stylometric and lexical representations remain more stable. Even after T3 removes formatting, capitalization, punctuation, symbols, and emojis, the lexical representation remains the strongest individual signal group. This suggests that model-specific word choices and local lexical patterns persist after visible surface signals are suppressed. Embedding accuracy also declines under T1–T3, indicating that frozen representations capture some of this affected lexical and stylistic information rather than semantic content alone.
blocks.zh: 表2列出了八向跨家庭的归属结果,机会水平为12.5%。 结果显示,归属不仅依赖于格式化信号和响应模板. 行为特征显示在边缘裁剪(T1)和格式去除(T2)下相对下降幅度最大,与反应结构的直接编码一致,而时态和词典表示仍然比较稳定. 即使在T3去除格式化,资本化,平分化,符号化,和emojis之后,词典化代表仍然是最强的单个信号组. 这表明在可见地表信号被压制后,模型特有词选择和地表地表法模式持续存在. 在T1-T3下,嵌入精度也下降,表明被冻结的表述能够捕捉到其中一部分受影响的词汇和语义信息,而不只是语义内容。

blocks.en: Paraphrasing produces a complementary pattern. Accuracy decreases from P1 to P2 as more of the original text is rewritten, and falls further in P1 ∗ and P2 ∗ after applying T3. Combined performs best on the raw and paraphrased views, whereas the Lexical representation slightly exceeds it under T1–T3. This shift is consistent with paraphrasing weakening lexical realization while T3 removes additional structural and surface signals. Even under P2 ∗ , all representations remain above chance, with Combined reaching 55.87%. Substantial cross-family information therefore remains recoverable after both lexical realization and visible surface form are heavily altered.
blocks.zh: 缩写产生一种互补模式。 准确度从P1降至P2,因为更多的原始文本被改写,在应用了T3之后,在P1*和P2*中进一步下降。 合并在原始和被解释的观点上表现得最好,而在T1-T3中,Lexical代表略微超过它。 这种偏移与变相弱化的词汇实现一致,而T3则去除额外的结构和表面信号. 即使在P2*下,所有陈述都高于机会,合计达到55.87%。 因此,在字典化和可见的地表形式被严重改变后,大量跨家族信息仍然可以恢复。

blocks.en: The Prompt-Neutralized Embedding (PN Embedding) achieves the highest accuracy across all views. We report it separately because it is a diagnostic, prompt-relative representation rather than a standard standalone classifier input. Unlike the other representations, PN Embedding requires peer responses from all candidate models to the same prompt so that their shared embedding mean can be removed. Its strong performance suggests that removing prompt- and task-shared variation exposes model-specific signals that are more discriminative and less dependent on the prompt itself. This finding also motivates the analysis of generalization across prompt distributions in Sec. 5 . Corresponding results for the MLP classifier are provided in Appendix B . Across the reported settings, the largest standard deviation is 3.2%, indicating relatively low variability. To avoid overloading the tables, we omit standard deviations from the main presentation.
blocks.zh: 快速-神经化嵌入(PN Embedding)在所有视图中实现最高的准确性. 我们单独报告,因为它是一种诊断性、即时和相对的表述,而不是标准的独立分类器输入。 与其他表示不同的是,PN Embedding要求所有候选模型对同一快取的同级响应,以便其共享的嵌入平均值被去除. 它的强效表现表明,去除即时和任务分担的变异会暴露出模型特有的信号,这些信号更具有歧视性并较少依赖于即时本身. 这一结论还促使人们分析第5节中迅速分发的概况。 MLP分类器的相应结果载于附录B。 在整个报告设置中,最大的标准偏差为3.2%,表明变化较小。 为了避免表格超载,我们省略了主演示文稿中的标准偏差.

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that model identity remains detectable among closely related Llama models, although accuracy is substantially lower than in the cross-family setting. The Combined representation performs best for most pairs, suggesting that distinctions between related models draw on multiple complementary signal groups. The Lexical representation is generally the strongest individual signal group, while behavioral and embedding representations provide weaker separation. Pairwise difficulty is not determined by parameter count alone: differences across model generations are often easier to detect than size differences within the same generation. Overall, within-family attribution appears to rely on several weak but complementary signals rather than a single dominant fingerprint. Full transformation results for the Llama within-family pairs are provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en: The same broad pattern extends to the other model families, although fingerprint strength varies considerably across them. blocks.en: Table 4 shows that distilled students remain readily distinguishable from their teachers. Compared with the standard within-family comparisons in Tables 3 and 15 , the teacher–student pairs are similarly or more separable. The Llama teacher–student pair is more separable than any of the Llama pairs, while the Mistral pair is nearly perfectly separable. The Gemma pair shows performance comparable to the corresponding within-family comparison. The Combined representation performs best for Llama and Gemma, whereas nearly all representations strongly separate the Mistral pair. PN Embedding provides additional gains, particularly for Llama and Gemma. Overall, shared model lineage does not imply similar fingerprints. The changes introduced through distillation can leave a strong and detectable model-specific signature. Full transformation results for each teacher–student pair are provided in Appendix E .

Neighboring Llama variants remain near chance across signal groups, while Qwen retains a modest local signal. Overall, adaptation can make a model increasingly distinguishable from its base even when successive variants remain difficult to resolve.
blocks.zh: 表20显示了整个行为、定时、语义和语义表述的总体模式。 相邻的"Llama"变体在信号组之间仍然近乎偶然,而"Quen"则保留了适度的局部信号. 总体而言,即使相继的变体仍然难以解决,适应也可以使模型与其基础更加相去甚远。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Cross-family attribution under P2 ∗ across word budgets and text positions.
blocks.zh: 图3:P2*项下的跨家庭归属,按字数预算和文本位置分列。

blocks.en: Figure 3 examines how attribution changes with the amount and location of available text under P2 ∗ , our strongest transformation. Even 50 words retain useful identifying information, with accuracy of approximately 22% for the beginning and center and 27% for the ending, compared with a 12.5% chance level. Accuracy increases steadily with the amount of available text and reaches about 50% for the full response.
blocks.zh: 图3审查了在P2*下现有文本的数量和位置如何改变归属,这是我们最强的转变。 即使是50个字都保留了有用的识别信息,起始和中段的准确度大约为22%,结尾为27%,而概率水平为12.5%。 准确性随着现有文本数量稳步增加,完整答复达到50%左右.

blocks.en: The ending is the most informative region at every limited word budget, suggesting that later parts of a response retain more model-specific information after paraphrasing and surface normalization. The corresponding T0 and T3 analyses in Appendix G show the same accumulation pattern at higher accuracy levels. Overall, attribution depends on both the amount of available text and the extent to which its identifying signals have been altered.
blocks.zh: 结尾是每个有限字预算中信息最丰富的区域,说明答复的后半部分保留了更具体模型的信息,然后是去解析和表面正常化. 附录G中相应的T0和T3分析显示在更精确的水平上相同的积累模式. 总体而言,归属取决于现有文本的数量及其识别信号被改变的程度。

blocks.en: 5 Do Fingerprints Generalize?
blocks.zh: 5 指纹通用吗?

blocks.en:

by task type when training on D1, D2, and D4. Chance accuracy is 12.5%.

blocks.en: We next test whether model fingerprints generalize beyond the conditions under which they are learned. We consider two complementary shifts, changes in prompt distribution and changes in language, to assess whether attribution relies on signals that persist across prompts and languages.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来要测试 模型指纹是否超越学习条件 我们考虑了两个相辅相成的转变,即迅速分发的改变和语言的改变,以评估归属是否依赖于各种提示和语言中持续存在的信号。

blocks.en: 5.1 Cross-Dataset Generalization
blocks.zh: 5.1 跨数据集通论

blocks.en: We train the attribution classifier on three prompt datasets and evaluate it on the held-out fourth, repeating this for each dataset. As shown in Table 5 (a), accuracy remains well above the 12.5% chance level in every split, with a mean of 75.52%. Performance is higher on D1 and D2, which share a data source, than on the more distinct D3 and D4 distributions. Prompt distribution therefore affects fingerprint recoverability without erasing model identity.
blocks.zh: 我们在三个快速数据集上对归属分类器进行培训,并在被搁置的第四个数据集上对其进行评价,重复每个数据集。 如表5(a)所显示,准确性仍然远远高于每分12.5%的机会水平,平均为75.52%。 共享数据源的D1和D2的性能高于比较独特的D3和D4分布. 因此,迅速分发会影响指纹的可回收性,而不去除模型身份。

blocks.en: The same pattern holds under stronger text transformations. Across T0, T3, and P2 ∗ , holding out the target dataset reduces Combined accuracy by only 4.8–5.9 points relative to mixed-source evaluation, whereas transforming the responses causes substantially larger losses. Lexical nearly matches Combined on raw text and is strongest among the standard representations under T3, while Combined performs better under P2 ∗ after paraphrasing weakens lexical information. Distribution shift therefore has a measurable but smaller effect than directly removing or rewriting model-identifying signals.
blocks.zh: 在更强有力的文本转换中,同样的模式保持不变。 在整个T0、T3和P2 ∗ 中,坚持目标数据集,与混合来源评价相比,综合精度只减少了4.8至5.9分,而改变反应则造成更大的损失。 词汇几乎与原始文本相匹配,在T3下的标准表述中最强;而P2* 下,词语组合的性能较好,削弱了词汇信息。 因此,分配相变比直接去掉或重写模型识别信号具有可测量但较小的效果.

blocks.en: Table 5 (b) shows stronger variation across D3 task types. Attribution remains reliable for explanation, argument/advice, and creative generation, but drops sharply for rewriting and source synthesis. These tasks constrain more of the response content and structure, leaving less room for model-specific variation. This pattern is also consistent with the strong PN Embedding results in Appendix H.1 , where removing prompt-shared variation makes model differences more visible. Detailed transformed and per-model results are provided in Appendix H.2 .
blocks.zh: 表5(b)显示,D3任务类别的差异较大。 归属对于解释,论证/建议,以及创造性生成来说仍然是可靠的,但对于重写和源合成来说却急剧下降. 这些任务制约了更多的响应内容和结构,为模型特定变异留下了较少的空间. 这种模式也与附录H.1中强烈的PN嵌入结果相符合,其中去除即时共享的变异使模型差异更明显. 附录H.2提供了详细的转换结果和按模式分列的结果。

blocks.en: 5.2 Within-Language
blocks.zh: 5.2 语言内部

blocks.en: To assess fingerprint recoverability within each language, we use an LLM to translate the English prompts into Persian and Mandarin Chinese and then perform the same eight-way cross-family attribution task on responses generated in each language. The translation procedure and prompt are provided in Appendix H.3 .
blocks.zh: 为了评估每种语言的指纹可恢复性,我们使用LLM将英语提示翻译为波斯语和普通汉语,然后就每种语言生成的响应执行同样的八向跨家族归属任务. 附录H.3规定了翻译程序和及时性。

blocks.en: The Persian and Mandarin Chinese results in Appendix I follow the same broad pattern as English. Attribution decreases as surface signals are removed, drops further under paraphrasing, and is lowest under P2 ∗ . Even then, all representations remain above the 12.5% chance level. Lexical is strongest across most signal-suppressed views, while Combined becomes more competitive after paraphrasing. PN Embedding improves over the standard Semantic representation in every view, but usually remains below the strongest Lexical or Combined results in Persian and Chinese. Overall, fingerprint persistence extends beyond English, although its strength varies across languages.
blocks.zh: 附录一中波斯语和普通话汉语的成绩与英语的大致模式相同. 随着表面信号的去除,分配减少,在比喻下进一步下降,在P2*下最小。 即便如此,所有陈述都高于12.5%的机会水平。 在大多数信号被压制的视图中,Lexical最强,而组合在被渲染后更具竞争力. PN Embedding在每一种观点中都比标准语义代表有所改进,但通常仍然低于波斯语和汉语最强的语义或综合结果. 总体而言,指纹的持久性超越了英语,尽管其强度因语言而异.

blocks.en: 5.3 Cross-Lingual
blocks.zh: 5.3 语文

blocks.en: Because word- and character-level lexical features are strongly tied to language and script, we exclude the Lexical representation from the cross-lingual transfer experiments. Table 6 evaluates transfer by training the classifier in one language and testing it in another. Accuracy remains above chance in all six directions. Transfer is weaker than within-language attribution and varies across language pairs, showing that only part of the model-specific signal is shared across languages.
blocks.zh: 由于词和字符级的词典特征与语言和脚本有很强的联系,所以我们把Lexical的代表从跨语言转移实验中排除了出来. 表6通过对分类人员进行一种语言的培训以及用另一种语言进行测试来评估转移情况。 准确性在所有六个方面都高于机会。 转录比语言内部的归属更弱并因语言对等而有差异,表明只有部分模式特有信号在语言间共享.

blocks.en: The feature results show where this transferable signal is concentrated. Stylometric features transfer poorly, consistent with their dependence on language-specific grammatical and stylistic patterns. Behavioral features remain useful in several directions, while Semantic and Combined representations are generally stronger. PN Embedding improves transfer in every direction, often substantially, indicating that removing prompt-shared variation reveals a more stable model-relative signal.
blocks.zh: 特征结果显示了这个可转移信号的聚集地. 时态特征转移不良,符合其对语言特有语法和语法模式的依赖. 行为特征在几个方向上仍然有用,而语义和综合表述则普遍更强. PN Embedding在每一个方向上都改进了转移,常常是实质性的,这表明去除即时共享的变异会揭示出一个更稳定的模型相对信号.

blocks.en:
Appendix J reports average cross-lingual attribution performance across all six language-transfer settings under each response transformation. Accuracy declines from T0 through T3 as surface signals are removed, but remains above chance after severe Transformation. Paraphrasing alone has much less effect, with P1 and P2 retaining transfer close to the raw setting. The largest degradation appears under P1 ∗ and P2 ∗ , where paraphrasing is combined with T3.
Overall, cross-lingual attribution appears to rely on cross-linguistically shared behavioral and structural patterns, together with more persistent model-specific signals that survive substantial changes in wording and form.
blocks.zh:
附 录 J报告每个响应转换下所有六个语言转换设置的平均跨语言归属业绩。 由于地表信号被去除而从T0到T3的准确度下降,但在严重转变后仍然高于机会. 光是比喻效果要小得多,P1和P2保留了接近原始设置的转移. 最大的降解出现在P1*和P2*下,其中抛出物与T3结合.
总体而言,跨语言归属似乎依赖于跨语言共同的行为和结构模式,以及更持久的模式特有信号,这些信号在措辞和形式上都经历了实质性的变化.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented a multi-resolution study of LLM fingerprinting across model families, closely related models, distilled and LoRA-adapted variants, text transformations, prompt distributions, and languages. Model identity remains detectable at increasingly fine levels of similarity, although neighboring LoRA variants can be difficult to resolve. The identifying signal is distributed across multiple forms of evidence. Surface and behavioral signals are relatively fragile, lexical information remains strong after surface normalization, and combining signal types becomes more useful after paraphrasing. Fingerprints also transfer substantially across prompt distributions and languages, but recoverability depends strongly on the task. Attribution drops sharply for highly constrained tasks such as rewriting and source synthesis, where the prompt leaves less freedom for model-specific variation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了关于LLM指纹跨模范家族的多解析研究、密切相关的模型、蒸馏和LORA适应的变体、文本转换、迅速分发和语言。 虽然相邻的LORA变体可能难以解决,但模型身份在越来越细的相似度下仍然可以被探测出. 识别信号分布于多种证据形式. 地表信号和行为信号相对脆弱,地表正常化后词汇信息仍然很强,而将信号类型组合起来,在拓扑后会更加有用. 指纹在迅速分发和各种语言之间也有很大的转移,但恢复能力在很大程度上取决于任务。 重写和源合成等高度受限的任务的归属率会急剧下降,因为当即给模型特定变异留下了较少的自由度.

blocks.en: These findings support a view of LLM fingerprints as layered rather than tied to a single observable feature. Our fingerprint-resolution framework makes this dependence explicit by studying both how similar the candidate models are and how much identifying evidence remains available. The strong performance of PN Embedding further shows that removing variation shared across responses to the same prompt can substantially improve model separation, especially when task constraints are strong. Together, our results show that fingerprint recoverability depends jointly on model similarity, signal type, prompt and task constraints, and the transformations applied to the text, providing a broader diagnostic view of where model-specific behavior resides and when it remains observable.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果支持将LLM指纹看成是分层的,而不是与一个单一的可观测特征联系在一起。 我们的指纹解析框架通过既研究候选模型的相似性,又研究现有多少识别证据,明确了这种依赖性。 PN Embedding的强效表现进一步表明,消除同一时段反应中共有的差异可以大大地改善模型分离,特别是在任务限制很强的情况下. 我们的结果显示,指纹的可恢复性共同取决于模型的相似性、信号类型、即时性和任务限制,以及适用于文本的转换,从而提供了对模型特定行为所在位置和何时仍可观察到的更广泛的诊断。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Although our prompt sets are designed to cover diverse and largely general-purpose requests, they cannot represent the full range of prompts, interaction styles, and usage patterns encountered in everyday use. The multilingual experiments are limited to English, Chinese, and Persian, with non-English prompts translated from the English set rather than independently authored in each language. The controlled LoRA analysis uses two base models and two reasoning adaptations and may not reflect other adaptation methods or domains. Our evaluation also assumes a closed set of candidate models, whereas real-world provenance may involve unknown or unseen generators. PN Embedding is used as a diagnostic representation because it requires responses from all candidate models to the same prompt and is therefore not applicable to standard single-response attribution. Finally, our transformation suite cannot capture the full range of human editing, rewriting, translation, and post-processing that model outputs may undergo in practice.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的快件集旨在涵盖多种多样的、基本上通用的请求,但它们不能代表日常使用中遇到的快件、互动风格和使用模式。 多语种实验仅限于英语,中文和波斯语,非英语的提示从英语集中翻译出,而不是以每种语言独立编写. 受控LORA分析使用两个基础模型和两个推理适应,可能不反映其他适应方法或领域. 我们的评价还假定一套封闭的候选模式,而现实世界的出处可能涉及未知或看不见的发电机。 PN Embedding被用作诊断性表述,因为它要求所有候选模型对同一种即时反应,因此不适用于标准的单一反应归属. 最后,我们的转换套件无法捕捉模型输出可能在实践中进行的各种人类编辑、改写、翻译和后处理。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our method is intended as a diagnostic tool for studying model-specific generation patterns, not as a definitive detector of AI-generated text or as a standalone basis for decisions about individuals. Attribution errors remain possible, particularly under distribution shifts and text transformations, and results should therefore be interpreted with appropriate caution in high-stakes settings. We release the generated model outputs to support reproducibility and further research. Because the dataset contains more than 15,000 generations, the outputs were not exhaustively screened for potentially harmful, offensive, or otherwise undesirable content. They reflect the behavior of the source models at the time of generation and should not be interpreted as endorsed content. Downstream users are responsible for applying appropriate safeguards and complying with the relevant model and data-use terms.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法旨在作为研究模型特定生成模式的诊断工具,而不是作为AI生成文本的确定探测器,也不是关于个人的决定的独立依据. 分配错误仍然是可能的,特别是在分配班次和文本转换的情况下,因此,在高调环境中,对结果的解释应适当谨慎。 我们公布产生的模型产出,以支持可复制性和进一步研究。 由于数据集包含15 000多代人,因此并未对产出进行详尽筛选,以了解可能有害、令人反感或其他不良内容。 它们反映了源模型在生成时的行为,不应被解释为被认可的内容. 下游用户负责适用适当的保障措施并遵守相关的模型和数据使用术语.

blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement

blocks.en: The main text and appendices describe the experimental design, model and feature configurations, transformations, evaluation protocols, and additional implementation details needed to reproduce our results. We also make available the prompt datasets used in the study, all generated outputs comprising more than 15,000 generations from over 19 models, and the code used for model generation, LoRA fine-tuning, feature extraction, and classifier training and evaluation. These materials will be made publicly available on GitHub 1 1 1 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Fingerprint-Resolution to support independent verification and extension of the experiments.

blocks.en: A.2 Design and Construction of the D3 Control Set
blocks.zh: A.2 D3控制装置的设计和建造

blocks.en: D3 is designed as a controlled complement to the naturally occurring prompt collections used elsewhere in the study. The authors first specify five task categories that differ in their objectives, response constraints, and expected difficulty: explanation , argument and advice , creative writing , rewriting , and source synthesis . Table 7 describes each task.
blocks.zh: D3是作为研究中其他地方使用的自然出现的即时收藏的一种可控补充. 作者首先指定了五个任务类别,它们的目标、反应限制和预期的困难各不相同:解释、论据和建议、创造性写作、改写和源合成。 表7说明了每项任务。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Task categories in the D3 control set.
blocks.zh: 表7:D3控制集中的任务类别。

blocks.en: After defining this structure, we use GPT-5.6 Sol to generate 40 prompts for each category, producing 200 prompts in total. The model is instructed to maintain the predefined category boundaries while varying topics, scenarios, and requested outputs. The authors determine the task taxonomy, category balance, and construction requirements, while GPT-5.6 Sol is used only to draft the individual prompt texts.
blocks.zh: 在定义了这个结构后,我们使用GPT-5.6 Sol为每个类别生成40个提示,总共产生200个提示. 该模型被指示维持预先界定的类别界限,同时不同主题,情景,以及请求的产出. 作者确定任务分类、类别平衡和构造要求,而GPT-5.6 Sol只用于起草单个即时文本。

blocks.en: All generated prompts subsequently undergo human review. Each prompt is evaluated for clarity, category fit, duplication, and whether it provides a meaningful task for every candidate model. The final set retains an equal number of prompts from each category. Prompt selection is completed before collecting the model responses and does not use attribution results or downstream classifier performance.
blocks.zh: 所有产生的提示随后都经过了人类审查。 评价每个提示是否明确、适合类别、重复,以及是否为每个候选模式提供了有意义的任务。 最终集保留了每类中相同数量的提示. 在收集模型响应之前完成快速选择,不使用归属结果或下游分类器性能.

blocks.en: This construction provides several experimental benefits. First, exact category balance prevents the distribution from being dominated by a common task type. Second, the categories span different levels of response freedom, from open-ended creative generation to tightly constrained rewriting and source-grounded synthesis. This variation makes it possible to examine whether model fingerprints become weaker when the task restricts the linguistic choices available to the generator. Finally, constructing a novel prompt set reduces the risk that evaluated models reproduce memorized responses to established benchmark questions. Therefore, D3 is an AI-assisted, researcher-designed, and human-reviewed control set .
blocks.zh: 这一建筑提供了几项实验效益. 第一,精确的类别平衡防止分配被共同的任务类型所支配. 第二,这些类别跨越不同程度的响应自由度,从无限制的创作生成到严格限制的重写和以源头为基础的合成. 这种变化使得有可能在任务限制生成者可用的语言选择时,检查模型指纹是否变得更弱. 最后,建造一套新式的即时电源可减少被评价的模型重复对既定基准问题作出已记住的答复的风险。 因此,D3是人工智能辅助、研究人员设计和人审查的控制装置。

blocks.en: A.3 Generation Setting
blocks.zh: A.3 世代设定

blocks.en: Raw responses are generated with temperature 1.0 1.0 , top- p = 0.9 p=0.9 , and a maximum of 2,048 output tokens. Raw generations are stored before any transformation. Response embeddings use text-embedding-3-small with 1,536 dimensions. We also evaluated several open-source embedding models. Among the models tested, text-embedding-3-small achieved the strongest attribution performance and is therefore used throughout the reported experiments.
blocks.zh: 原始响应的生成温度为1.0-1.0,上-p=0.9p=0.9,最大输出符号为2,048. 原始世代在任何变相之前就被储存. 反应嵌入使用有1,536个维度的文本-嵌入-3-小. 我们还评价了几种开源嵌入模型。 在所测试的模型中,文本嵌入-3-小取得了最强的归属性能,因此在整个报告的实验中都得到了使用.

blocks.en: Throughout the paper, we use model fingerprint to denote source-specific traces in the output of a generator under a fixed generation setup. In black-box API settings, such traces may reflect both the underlying model and components of the serving stack. Our controlled LoRA experiments complement this setting by holding the base model and generation protocol fixed while varying the contribution of a learned weight update, showing that weight-level changes themselves can also produce detectable traces.
blocks.zh: 在整个论文中,我们使用模型指纹来表示在固定生成装置下发电机输出中特定源的痕迹. 在黑盒 API 设置中,这种痕迹可能同时反映服务堆栈的基本模型和组件. 我们控制的LORA实验通过固定基模和生成协议来补充这种设置,同时改变学习到的重量更新的贡献,表明重量级的变化本身也可以产生可探测的痕迹.

blocks.en: For an n n -gram sequence, the repetition ratio is the proportion of repeated n n -grams relative to all observed n n -grams. It is set to zero when the response is too short to form the corresponding n n -gram.

blocks.en: We use 17 dense features:
blocks.zh: 我们使用17个密集特征:

blocks.en: • Vocabulary diversity: token count, unique-token count, type–token ratio, MATTR-10, and MATTR-50. • Word form: mean and standard deviation of word length. • Vocabulary distribution: hapax ratio and most-common-word frequency ratio. • Function and grammatical words: function-word ratio, pronoun ratio, modal ratio, and connective ratio. • Repetition and numeric use: unigram, bigram, and trigram repetition ratios, and numeric-token ratio.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 词汇多样性: 符号计数, 独有的托肯计数, 类型- 托肯比, MATTR- 10, 和 MATTR- 50. ^ 单词形式: 字长的平均值和标准偏差 。 二. 支助 词汇分布:平分率和最常用词频率比. • 函数和语法词:函数-词比、代名词比、模式比和连接比。 • 重复和数字使用:unigram、bigram和三克重复比率,和数字-托肯比率。

blocks.en: Vocabulary diversity: token count, unique-token count, type–token ratio, MATTR-10, and MATTR-50.
blocks.zh: 词汇多样性:符号计数,特有托肯计数,类型-托肯比,MATTR-10,和MATTR-50.

blocks.en: Word form: mean and standard deviation of word length.
blocks.zh: 单词形式:词长的正与标准偏差.

blocks.en: Vocabulary distribution: hapax ratio and most-common-word frequency ratio.
blocks.zh: 词汇分布:平分率和最常用词频率比.

blocks.en: Function and grammatical words: function-word ratio, pronoun ratio, modal ratio, and connective ratio.
blocks.zh: 函数和语法词:函数-词比,代名词比,模式比,和连接比.

blocks.zh: 复用和数字用法:单格法,比格拉姆法和三克复用比,和数-托克比.

blocks.en: MATTR is computed as the mean type–token ratio over sliding windows of 10 or 50 tokens. For responses shorter than the specified window, the type–token ratio of the available response is used. The hapax ratio measures the proportion of vocabulary items that occur exactly once.
blocks.zh: MATTR 是以10个或50个令牌的滑动窗口的平均值类型相比计算的。 对于短于指定窗口的响应,则使用可用响应的类型-托肯比. phamax 比率测量词汇项发生一次的比例 。

blocks.en: The dense stylometric features are concatenated with POS unigram, bigram, and trigram TF–IDF features. POS sequences are extracted using spaCy en_core_web_sm . The POS vectorizer uses min_df=2 and retains at most 2,500 features. The resulting representation is the Stylometric representation used throughout the paper.
blocks.zh: 密度分型特征与POS unigram, bigram, 三克TF-IDF等特征相接. POS 序列使用 spar 提取 Cy en_core_web_sm. (中文(简体) ). POS矢量器使用min_df=2并保留了最多2500个特性. 由此产生的表述方式是整个文件所用的定型表述方式。

blocks.en: We concatenate two TF–IDF representations:
blocks.zh: 我们召集两个TF-IDF代表:

blocks.en: • lowercase word unigrams and bigrams, with at most 5,000 features; • lowercase character 3 3 – 5 5 -grams, with at most 5,000 features.
blocks.zh: ^ 小写单词"unigram"和"bigram",最多有5000个特征;^ 小写字符3 → 5 5-克,最多有5000个特征.

blocks.en: lowercase word unigrams and bigrams, with at most 5,000 features;
blocks.zh: 小写单词和大写单词,最多有5,000个特性;

blocks.en: lowercase character 3 3 – 5 5 -grams, with at most 5,000 features.
blocks.zh: 小写字符 3 – 5 5-克,最多具有5000个特性.

blocks.en: Both use min_df=2 and sublinear term-frequency scaling. The combined representation therefore contains at most 10,000 dimensions.
blocks.zh: 两者都使用min_df=2和子线性术语-频率缩放. 因此,综合表述最多包含一万个维度。

blocks.en: Each response is embedded using text-embedding-3-small , producing a 1,536-dimensional vector. Every transformed or paraphrased response is embedded after the transformation is applied; embeddings from the raw response are not reused. Embedding dimensions are standardized using statistics computed from the training fold.
blocks.zh: 每个响应都采用文本-嵌入-3-小来嵌入,产生出1,536维向量. 每个变换或变换后的反应在被应用后被嵌入;从生反应中嵌入的不被再用. 嵌入层面是标准化的,使用从培训组合中计算出的统计数据。

blocks.en: Although these representations are primarily designed to capture semantic information, they can also retain lexical, stylistic, and structural signals. This is reflected in our results, where attribution performance using the Semantic representation declines as progressively stronger text transformations are applied. We therefore use the term Semantic to denote the representation’s primary purpose, rather than to imply that it encodes semantic information exclusively.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些表示主要是为了捕捉语义信息而设计的,但是它们也可以保留词汇,语义,和结构信号. 这一点反映在我们的成果中,即随着文本的逐步更强有力的转变,使用语义表述的归属业绩下降。 因此,我们使用语义一词来表示代表的主要目的,而不是暗示它只将语义信息编码。

blocks.en: For each prompt and response view, we compute the mean embedding across all candidate-model responses and subtract it from each individual response embedding:
blocks.zh: 对于每个即时反应观点,我们计算在所有候选式反应中嵌入的平均值,并从每个嵌入的单个反应中减去:

blocks.en: e ¯ p , t = 1 K ​ ∑ m = 1 K e p , m , t , e p , m , t ′ = e p , m , t − e ¯ p , t . \bar{e}_{p,t}=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{m=1}^{K}e_{p,m,t},\qquad e^{\prime}_{p,m,t}=e_{p,m,t}-\bar{e}_{p,t}.

This removes components shared across responses to the same prompt and emphasizes relative differences between candidate models. Because this representation requires access to the other candidate responses for the same test prompt, we use it only as a diagnostic representation rather than as a standard single-response attribution setting.
blocks.zh: 这删除了对同一即时反应的共享组件,并强调了候选模式之间的相对差异. 由于这种表述要求同一测试即时获得其他候选人的答复,我们仅将其作为诊断表述,而不是标准单一反应归属设定。

blocks.en: The combined representation concatenates the four main signal groups: behavioral and structural features, stylometric and POS features, word and character TF–IDF, and frozen embeddings. Same-prompt centered embeddings are excluded. Dense behavioral, lexical, and embedding features are standardized using training-fold statistics, while POS and word/character TF–IDF features retain their sparse representations.
blocks.zh: 综合表示使四个主要信号组:行为和结构特征,时态和POS特征,词和字符TF-IDF,和被冻结的嵌入. 同一即时中心嵌入被排除在外. 敏锐的行为、词汇和嵌入式特征是使用培训文件夹统计实现标准化的,而POS和字/字符TF-IDF特征则保留了它们稀少的表述。

blocks.en: We hypothesize that subtracting the prompt-wise mean response embedding reduces variation shared across candidate models, much of which reflects the prompt and task, and makes model-specific differences easier to detect. blocks.zh: 我们假设,如果减去迅速而平均的反应嵌入,就会减少各候选模型之间共享的变异,这些变异大多反映了迅速和任务,使模型特有的差异更容易被发现。 表23支持这一假设。 居中将嵌入式归属的整体准确度从50.50%提高到74.88%.

blocks.en:
The comparison with the other representations is particularly informative. PN Embedding is comparable to Lexical on explanation and argument/advice tasks and slightly stronger on creative writing. Its clearest advantage appears on the more constrained tasks. For rewriting and source synthesis, PN Embedding exceeds the strongest standard representation by 12.81 and 13.75 points, respectively.
These tasks restrict the content and structure of the response, causing outputs from different models to share more task-related information. Removing this shared component exposes model-specific variation that is less visible in the original embedding space. Because centering requires responses from all candidate models to the same prompt, it is best understood as a prompt-relative analysis of model separation rather than a standard attribution setting.

blocks.en: Table 21 reports per-model recall across the five D3 task categories under cross-dataset generalization. The results show substantial variation across task types and models. Recall is generally higher for explanation, argument/advice, and creative generation, whereas rewrite and source-synthesis tasks show lower recall for several models. Thus, the aggregate task-level differences in the main text are not uniform across all models. These differences also have practical implications for provenance analysis. In rewrite and source-synthesis workflows, the lower attribution accuracy may make it more difficult to identify the model responsible for a given output after it has been transformed or conditioned on source material. Conversely, when model provenance is important, task-specific attribution performance can be considered when evaluating or auditing model outputs rather than relying on results from more open-ended generation alone.
blocks.zh: 表21按模式列出跨数据集一般化下五个D3任务类别的情况。 结果表明,任务类型和模式差异很大。 在解释、论证/建议和创造性生成方面,召回率一般较高,而重写和源合成任务显示若干模型召回率较低。 因此,正文中的总任务级别差异并不是在所有模型中都是统一的. 这些差异也对出处分析产生实际影响. 在重写和源合成工作流程中,较低的归属精确度可能使得在某一产出被转换或以源材料为条件后,更难确定负责该产出的模型. 反之,当模型来源很重要时,在评价或审计模型产出时,可以考虑具体任务的归属业绩,而不只是依靠更开放的一代的成果。

blocks.en: H.3 Multilingual Prompt Translation
blocks.zh: H.3 多语种即时翻译

blocks.en: For the multilingual experiments, we translate the D1–D4 English prompts into Persian and Mandarin Chinese before generating model responses. Translation uses gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 with temperature 0, top- p = 1 p=1 , and a maximum of 4,096 output tokens. Persian translations use standard Persian script, while Mandarin translations use Simplified Chinese characters.
blocks.zh: 对于多语种实验,我们先将D1–D4英语提示翻译为波斯语和普通汉语,再生成模型响应. 翻译使用gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18,温度为0,上-p=1p=1,最高输出符号为4,096个. 波斯语译名使用标准波斯文,而普通话译名使用简化汉字.

blocks.en: The translation procedure is designed to preserve the original task rather than adapt or execute it. The model is instructed to return only the translated prompt, preserve names, dates, numbers, constraints, requested tone, and meaningful line breaks, and retain literal fragments such as code, URLs, identifiers, and placeholders when appropriate. Prompts requesting code, diagrams, images, or other artifacts are translated as instructions rather than executed. We use the following system prompt, where [TARGET LANGUAGE] is replaced by the corresponding language specification:
blocks.zh: 翻译程序旨在保留原有的任务,而不是调整或执行. 该模型被指示只返回已翻译的快取,保存姓名、日期、数字、限制、要求的语气和有意义的换行符,并酌情保留文字碎片,例如代码、URL、标识符和占位符。 请求代码、图表、图像或其他文物的提示被翻译为指示而不是执行。 我们使用以下系统即时,其中[TARGET LANGUAGE]被相应的语言规格所取代:

blocks.en: You are a translation engine. Translate the user’s entire prompt into [TARGET LANGUAGE]. STRICT OUTPUT CONTRACT: - Return ONLY the translated prompt itself and absolutely nothing else. - Do not add any introduction, explanation, note, label, quotation marks, or markdown fence. - NEVER write phrases such as "Here is the translation", "Translated prompt", "Translation:", or anything similar. - The first character of your response must be the first character of the translated prompt, and the last character must be the last character of the translated prompt. TRANSLATION RULES: - Translate the instruction; do NOT answer it, execute it, solve it, or follow it. - Some prompts request code, ASCII art, diagrams, images, scripts, or other non-prose outputs. Do NOT generate any requested code, ASCII art, diagram, image description output, or executable content. Translate the request itself as ordinary text for a downstream model. - If literal code, ASCII, a URL, HTML/XML, an identifier, or a placeholder already appears inside the source prompt, preserve that literal fragment when necessary and translate only the surrounding natural language. Do not invent new code or ASCII. - Preserve names, dates, numbers, constraints, requested tone, and meaningful line breaks. - Do not summarize, censor, improve, embellish, or rewrite the task beyond faithful translation.
blocks.zh: 你是一个翻译引擎。 将用户的全部提示翻译为 [TARGET LANGUAGE]. - 仅返回翻译的提示本身,绝对没有其他。 不添加任何介绍、解释、注释、标签、引号或下标围栏。 - 永远不要写诸如"这里是翻译","翻译的即时","翻译:"之类的短语,或者类似的东西. 您回复的第一个字符必须是被翻译的快件的第一个字符,最后一个字符必须是被翻译的快件的最后一个字符. 翻译规则: - 翻译指令;不回答指令,执行指令,解决指令,或遵循指令. - 部分提示请求代码,ASCII艺术,图表,图像,脚本,或其他非文章输出. 不生成任何请求的代码、 ASCII 艺术、 图表、 图像描述输出或可执行内容 。 将请求本身翻译为下游模型的普通文本. - 如果字面代码、 ASCII、 URL、 HTML/ XML、 标识符或占位符已经出现在源内, 必要时保留字面碎片, 只翻译周围的自然语言 。 不要发明新的代码或ASCII. - 保留名称、日期、数字、限制、要求的语气和有意义的换行。 不要总结、审查、改进、美化或改写超出忠实翻译的任务。

blocks.en: After translation, the eight representative models generate responses to the translated prompts using the same decoding configuration as the main English experiment, with temperature 1.0, top- p = 0.9 p=0.9 , and a maximum of 2,048 output tokens. Reasoning is disabled so that the generation protocol remains consistent across languages.

blocks.en: Appendix J Cross-Lingual Fingerprint Transfer
blocks.zh: 附录J 指纹传输

blocks.en: To examine whether model-specific fingerprints persist across languages, we train the attribution classifier on outputs in one language and evaluate it on outputs from another language. We consider all six directed transfers among English (EN), Persian (FA), and Mandarin Chinese (ZH). Evaluation uses the common set of 798 prompts and five prompt-disjoint folds, such that the translated counterpart of a target-language test prompt is never present in the source-language training split. Logistic-regression hyperparameters are selected using only the source-language training data. TF–IDF is excluded because its vocabulary is intrinsically tied to language and script. Table 26 averages accuracy over all six transfer directions.
blocks.zh: 为了审查不同语言的模型指纹是否持续存在,我们用一种语言对归属分类员进行产出方面的培训,并用另一种语言的产出来评价。 我们考虑在英语(EN)、波斯语(FA)和普通汉语(ZH)之间进行所有六项直接转让。 评价使用798个快取和5个快取分折的常见套件,因此在源语言培训分折中从未出现目标语言测试快取的翻译对应. 逻辑后退超参数只选用源语言培训数据. TF-IDF被排除在外,因为它的词汇与语言和脚本有着内在的联系. 表26 所有6个传输方向的平均准确性。

blocks.en: For cross-lingual experiments, we retain the same feature definition across languages to avoid changing the classifier representation between source and target languages. Consequently, some Stylometric components, including the English-trained POS representation, are not linguistically calibrated for Persian or Chinese. We therefore treat cross-lingual Stylometric accuracy as a fixed-feature diagnostic and do not interpret it as evidence of language-general POS structure.
blocks.zh: 对于跨语言实验,我们保留了不同语言的相同特征定义,以避免改变源语言与目标语言之间的分类代表. 因此,一些定型组件,包括英语训练的POS代表,没有为波斯语或汉语进行语言校正. 因此,我们把跨语言的Stylometic精度作为固定地貌诊断,不把它解释为语言一般POS结构的证据.
